title: Dividend Income by Month
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:investment transaction_type=dividend
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount_usd) as dividend_income_usd by account _time
| sort - _time
description: Uses Plaid investment transactions telemetry to monitor monthly dividend cash flow by account in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for income seasonality that is otherwise buried in broker portals, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid investment transactions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals monthly dividend cash flow by account so you can spot income seasonality that is otherwise buried in broker portals before it becomes annoying.
